item.title: 2028 Dem Race Heats Up, Historic Mississippi Flip, Migrant Tries to Hijack Plane: AM Update 11/13 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez reshuffles her political team as potential 2028 Democrat presidential contenders position themselves for White House bids through high-profile appearances and book releases. President Trump removes Vice President JD Vance from efforts to negotiate an end to the war with Iran, declaring that the US no longer needs a peace deal. Democrat Scott Colom defeats Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith in a historic upset, becoming the first Democrat elected to the US Senate from Mississippi since 1982. DHS reveals that a twice-deported Honduran national accused of attempting to hijack a United Airlines flight was granted asylum after claiming to be transgender.
